mapper.sql: SELECT task_id, task_no, task_type, source_type, source_no, material_id, material_code, material_name, supplier_id, supplier_name, batch_no, inspect_qty, aql_level, inspect_level, sample_size, ac_val, re_val, task_status, inspect_result, defect_level, inspector_id, inspector_name, inspect_time, judge_time, gauge_id, gauge_name, is_recheck, origin_task_id, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM qms_insp_task
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qms_insp_task ( task_no, task_type, source_type, source_no, material_id, material_code, material_name, supplier_id, supplier_name, batch_no, inspect_qty, aql_level, inspect_level, sample_size, ac_val, re_val, task_status, inspect_result, defect_level, inspector_id, inspector_name, inspect_time, judge_time, gauge_id, gauge_name, is_recheck, origin_task_id, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{taskNo}, #{taskType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceNo}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{batchNo}, #{inspectQty}, #{aqlLevel}, #{inspectLevel}, #{sampleSize}, #{acVal}, #{reVal}, #{taskStatus}, #{inspectResult}, #{defectLevel}, #{inspectorId}, #{inspectorName}, #{inspectTime}, #{judgeTime}, #{gaugeId}, #{gaugeName}, #{isRecheck}, #{originTaskId}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE qms_insp_task SET del_flag = '2' WHERE task_id IN #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qms_insp_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND source_no = #{sourceNo}
WHERE del_flag = '0' AND task_status = '0' AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{overdueDays} DAY) ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT task_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qms_insp_task WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY task_status
